1084-4279-6772.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1084-4279-6772.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Syr Vondam triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1084-4279-6772.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4550-5567-8227-8298--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5567-8227-8298--112.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
4550-5567-8227-8298--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Repeat.

339-677-969-8249.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

654-2577-7084-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
654-2577-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

728-4871-5220-5946.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You control at least three creatures with different powers.
728-4871-5220-5946.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

413-1580-2301-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Abzan Ascendancy and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

129-969-1409-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

957-3963-7722.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
957-3963-7722.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one
Move to your first extra turn.
Blink Thor using Meneldor.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Stretch from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your second extra turn.
Cast Time Stretch from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

1768-2921--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and Juniper Order Ranger.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat

206-3259-4053-7604.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control with mana value 3 or less.
You either control another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less, or have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-3259-4053-7604.description:
Declare Excava and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Excava triggers, returning up to one creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature with mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
206-3259-4053-7604.notes: If both creatures used have haste, you can ignore the haste enabler.

413-3490-4455-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
413-3490-4455-7426.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Ghost Lantern triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

5517-6871-7033.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Bumi triggers, untapping all lands you control, including Bumi as it's a land due to Toph, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

57-283-1115-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
57-283-1115-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3490-6723-7060-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-6723-7060-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

455-877-6986.description:
Cast Hoverguard Sweepers by paying {0}.
When Hoverguard Sweepers enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3532-4030-4842-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Chasm Skulker triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3769-4050-5571--6.easyPrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3769-4050-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Repeat from step 2.

1456-2034-5220.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
1456-2034-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

339-677-2511-5295.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

67-2781-4050.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reveillark.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Reveillark.
When Reveillark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian and up to one other creature with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

152-2034-2397-5446.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariot token enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers twice, creating four 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Cats, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
152-2034-2397-5446.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Cats and/or target any other artifact using Cogwork Assembler.

759-1247-4136-5963-6549.description:
Activate Roaring Earth by paying {1}{G}{G} and discarding it, causing Grove of the Burnwillows to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Marvin using Grove of the Burnwillows' second ability by tapping it, adding {R} or {G} and causing each opponent to lose 1 life due to Tainted Remedy.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

2533-2719-4681-5686.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Repeat.

1247-5832-5929.notablePrerequisites:
Joraga Treespeaker has at least five level counters on it.
Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
1247-5832-5929.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

101-372-961.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Against All Odds exiled by Abdel Adrian.
101-372-961.description:
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Vampire Charmseeker and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Vampire Charmseeker trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Against All Odds.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Vampire Charmseeker and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1496-2919-5641.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
1496-2919-5641.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

601-1636-5329.notablePrerequisites: Mutavault does not have summoning sickness.
601-1636-5329.description:
Activate Mutavault's second ability by paying {1}, causing it to become a 2/2 creature with all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Mutavault's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
When the Merfolk enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

2573-4377-4423-5155.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
2573-4377-4423-5155.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary and two other Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and returning Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Play any Island except Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play any Island except Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard, then play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting Walk the Aeons on top of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.

880-1659-3875.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Tireless Provisioner and Seed the Land trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

905-2178-4100.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Endbringer.
Endbringer does not have summoning sickness.
905-2178-4100.description:
Activate Endbringer's first ability by tapping it, targeting any creature.
Horobi triggers, destroying that creature.
When the creature dies, Endbringer triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
 You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

63-4013-4659.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Wernog.
Wernog leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering twice.
Resolve both of Wernog's triggers, creating at least two Clue tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing two Clue tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2182-3858-4053.description:
Play Dark Depths, which enters with zero ice counters due to Solemnity.
Dark Depths triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and create a 20/20 Marit Lage legendary creature token.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to gain ten life and win the game.

1310-4131-4893.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
1310-4131-4893.description:
Cast Karn's Touch by paying {U}{U}, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
